title: Hey Ya!
headline: André 3000 got the world dancing to a song full of doubts about love.
caption:
"Hey Ya!" came out in 2003 and sounds like pure joy. The verses are about a man wondering if his relationship is only running on tradition.

One more detail: releasing it as a single was a last-minute decision, so André 3000 had no time to choreograph the video. All of the dancing was improvised. He played all eight members of the fictional band The Love Below and performed the song 23 times during filming. His guitarist character, Johnny Vulture, was filmed last, and an exhausted André sat on a stool for those scenes.

Did you ever catch what the verses were about, or were you too busy dancing?

🎧 The song: "Hey Ya!" by OutKast (@outkast)
